source.name: LASK Onlineshop: Trikot Home 2026/27
source.quote: Trikot Home 2026/27 Offizielles Heimtrikot des LASK der Saison 2026/27
source.note: The product photo of the 2026/27 home shirt on this page (https://shop.lask.at/lask/download/ShopProdukte/f3649ad0-6e79-4f29-988a-1b37f10f401b) shows 'Original Kornspitz' across the front and backaldrin's arrow marks on the yellow sleeves. The club's business-partner page (https://www.lask.at/de/m/business) lists backaldrin Kornspitz under 'Leading Partner' (as a logo), and the club's 8 May 2024 news (https://www.lask.at/de/m/news/leading-partner-verlaengern-langfristig-lask-erhaelt-top-ausruester) says backaldrin extended for four years and has appeared as Trikotsponsor since 2020.

source.name: LASK Onlineshop: Trikot Home 2026/27
source.quote: Trikot Home 2026/27 Offizielles Heimtrikot des LASK der Saison 2026/27
source.note: The product photo of the 2026/27 home shirt on this page (https://shop.lask.at/lask/download/ShopProdukte/f3649ad0-6e79-4f29-988a-1b37f10f401b) shows the BWT mark on the upper chest, above the front sponsor. The club's business-partner page (https://www.lask.at/de/m/business) lists BWT under 'Leading Partner' (as a logo).

source.name: Footy Headlines, 'LASK 26-27 Home, Away & Third Kits Released'
source.quote: This is the new Adidas LASK home football shirt for 2026-2027.
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention. Same article: 'Produced by long-term technical sponsor Adidas'; the kit was unveiled 'during a recent club partner event'.

summary: Original Kornspitz (backaldrin) large on the front and BWT on the upper chest, with adidas as kit maker, in the official shop's product photo of the 2026/27 home shirt; the yellow sleeves carry backaldrin's arrow marks (Footy Headlines: the men's shirt keeps its 'sponsor-driven yellow sleeves', the women's version drops them), and the photo shows no back sponsor. Not marked complete: the photo is of the shirt as sold, and no cited source lists every mark on the match shirt (the shop sells the Bundesliga logo as an extra option).
